text_block_list.text:
Under the crystal-clear autumn sky— 
Thunderous cheers rang out to celebrate 
Mejiro McQueen's victory.

The spectators, the Trainer, and the 
Mejiro family. Blessed by so many people, 
she felt a joy beyond words well up in her 
heart.

Though she sometimes hesitated and 
struggled... she never gave up and kept on 
running—

She achieved the unprecedented feat—even 
for the prestigious Mejiro family—of 
"conquering both the Spring and Autumn 
Tenno Sho."
